scores.notes: Ink-and-watercolor night scene: Jacob asleep on a mat with a stone pillow in the lower foreground, and a swirling white-gold cloud with a flame-like core in the upper centre that has no face or body. The standing stone at centre has a small flame on top, so it reads a little like a candle; dark washes reach all four borders.

Gold-ground icon: Jacob asleep on a mat with a stone pillow, and a scalloped cloud with fire at its heart in the upper centre with no figure inside. The standing stone, piled-stone altar and Luz town are present, and the gold ground and landscape run to every edge.

Watercolor: Ezekiel on the riverbank, four winged living creatures with wheels, and a crowd on the right bank. At the top centre, the radiance holds a blue-glowing light inside a peaked outline that narrows at the top and widens at shoulder height. It has no face or limbs, but its outline could be read as a hooded or veiled silhouette, so it needs adjudication.

Watercolor: Daniel seen in profile in the left foreground, and men in white carrying thrones into place. The central seat (upper centre) holds only a column of fire and rays, with no figure, above a river of flame. Clouds reach every border.

Gold-ground icon: an Israelite column crosses dry ground between stylised water walls, under a swirled cloud with a flame inside (top centre) and no figure. A walled city on the far shore is an unrequested addition; the gold ground and water reach the edges.

Oil: in the centre background, a full robed human figure sits on the fiery throne, with hands on the armrests and white garments draped over the knees. Only the head is washed out by glow, so the Ancient of Days is shown with a body. Daniel and the white-robed assembly are otherwise as requested, and the edges are fully painted.

Watercolor crossing: families with sheep walk between foaming water walls, and a cloud pillar with an orange fire core rises at the top centre with no figure in it. In the bottom-right corner, among the pebble outlines, there is a small handwritten initials-like scribble ('Nf') that reads as a signature.

Gold-ground icon: Moses, Aaron in a breastplate, Nadab and Abihu with censers, and the elders stand on a blue sapphire pavement on the summit. Above them, a cloud with rays and a flame (top centre) holds no figure. The tents of the camp below reach the side edges.

Gold-ground icon: Ezekiel writing on the left bank, with four winged creatures (man, lion, ox and eagle) carrying wheels. In the upper centre is a blue throne-arch outline holding only a flame and rays, with no seated figure. Gold and landscape reach every edge.

Oil: inside the radiance at the top centre, above the four winged creatures, a faint translucent robed figure sits on a throne, with arms on the armrests and drapery over the lap under a fiery halo, so the 'likeness of a man' is given a body. There is also a tiny blue square artifact at the very top-right corner, but the edges are otherwise fully painted.

Watercolor: Isaiah with a raised hand in the temple court, and white-gold light pouring through the sanctuary doorway (upper left-centre) with incense smoke. No figure is visible at normal size. Under heavy contrast, faint pencil contours inside the left part of the doorway light resemble a raised hand or a wing fan, so this needs adjudication.

Oil night scene: Jacob asleep on a mat against a rock, beneath an amorphous glowing cloud with small flame wisps in the upper right that has no figure. The standing stone and altar are at the right. A legible cursive painter's signature is scratched into the grass in the bottom-right corner.

Gold-ground icon: empty golden thrones on clouds, and a central throne engulfed in a flame burst that pours a river of fire, with no figure on it (upper left-centre). The white-robed assembly is on the right and Daniel in the right foreground; the gold and clouds reach the edges.

Watercolor: Moses with a staff, Aaron in priestly dress, Nadab and Abihu with censers, and elders on a glassy blue tiled pavement, under a radiant cloud with a faint flame and no figure (top centre). The pale sky is painted pale blue right out to the side edges, not left as bare paper.

Watercolor: Sinai smoking around a sun-like radiance with no figure, and Moses with the people in the lower right. Along the upper left and right borders the sky washes stop short and leave bare cream paper texture, so the image vignettes into unpainted paper at the sides. Moses oddly holds two staffs, one in each hand.

Oil: Moses, Aaron in a breastplate, Nadab and Abihu with smoking censers, and the elders on a blue stone platform, with the camp in the left distance. The radiant cloud at the top centre is light only, with no figure. Moses holds a staff in each hand, which is a minor oddity; the edges are fully painted.

Oil: Sinai with billowing smoke spiralling around a bright light at the summit (top centre), with no figure. Moses stands with a staff before the crowd, and the ground is cracking from the quake; the edges are fully painted.

Oil: at the top centre, a clear bearded, white-haired man in robes sits enthroned in the clouds with a raised hand, surrounded by winged angels, so Yahweh is shown as a full human figure. Micaiah, the two seated kings, soldiers and the Samaria walls are otherwise as requested.

Oil: Isaiah with a staff before open golden temple doors carved with angel reliefs, and a shaft of light and cloud with a glowing fire bowl above the altar (upper centre) that has no figure. Smoke drifts across, and the edges are fully painted.

Oil crossing: Israelites with bundles and staves between dark water walls, under a cloud pillar with a faint fire glow (upper centre) that has no figure. In the sand at the bottom-right corner (about x 1290-1335, y 740-757) there is a very faint cursive-like scribble that may be a ghost signature, visible only when enhanced.

Flat icon-style painting: Isaiah with raised hands in a cedar-panelled sanctuary carved with cherubim and palms, and a cloud with rays and a flame at the top centre with no figure. The walls run to all edges.

Gold-ground icon: Sinai smoking and burning, with a cross-hatched diamond of light at the top centre and no figure. Moses stands with a staff between crowds of Israelites on cracked ground, with tents behind; the gold and figures reach the edges.

Gold-ground icon: at the top centre of the radiance, a translucent seated human figure of light with draped robe and outstretched arms is enthroned, which gives Yahweh a form. The surrounding host includes horned, demon-like creatures (upper left and right), which do not fit the 'army of heaven'.

Ink-and-watercolor: Micaiah points up at a cloud where a fire occupies the central throne place, flanked left and right by standing robed figures of the heavenly host, with nobody seated. A white-bearded figure and a red-and-blue-robed figure stand beside the fire but are part of the flanking host. The two kings sit with courtiers under the pavilion, soldiers are at the edges, and the painting fills the frame.
